findings.proof: BCL reproduction observed currentIsChild=True/currentIsParent=False after a throwing ActivityStopped callback. DiagnosticCollectorFailureTests covers actual callbacks, result42 and parent restoration.
findings.fix: Root protected activity start and disposal, restored the nearest live parent and counted collector failures; RetrievalTelemetry uses DiagnosticActivityScope.
findings.problem: Activity sampling/start/stop callbacks could block the business path or leave a stopped child as the current parent.

findings.proof: OpenAiCompatibleAdvancedAnalysisProviderDiagnosticsTests exercises 400/429, strict/non-strict, unreadable/timeout, caller cancellation, quota and a real5-second linked deadline with Retry-After.
findings.fix: Root added one bounded 64001-byte read, strict/non-strict handling, caller cancellation separation, quota classification from the same body and break before retry on elapsed deadline.
findings.problem: Unreadable HTTP rejection capture could replace provider status; body deadline could start a retry with an already-cancelled timeout token.

findings.fix: Client journal emits terminal events using their explicit owning state and restores live Activity parent.
findings.problem: Disposing a parent turn before its independent child emitted the parent terminal event into the child.

findings.fix: Client redactor covers documentPath/documentName, numeric credentials and string arrays while preserving numeric diagnosis.
findings.problem: Alternate document keys, numeric secrets and generic string arrays could leak into metadata support exports.

findings.problem: Tracker scope disposal occurred before cancellation/failure handling and could record the default failure outcome.

findings.proof: RequestIdCollectorFailureTests checks six begin/log/dispose by success/failure combinations, original exception identity and one business invocation.
